notes: A panel’s settings window now wears that panel’s own look. Open Panel Settings on the OG widget and the window arrives in OG’s colours, type, spacing and corners instead of the Control Panel’s.

The OG theme is now complete rather than colours alone: title bar, sidebar, tabs, headings, rows, labels, cards, inputs, buttons and scrollbars are all styled in OG’s language - one hairline, one accent heading, and nothing else, because…

The rule is general, not a special case for OG. Any panel whose theme also exists as a Control Panel theme gets this automatically; every other panel opens exactly as before, and the main Settings window is untouched.
